text: A small film crew enters the abandoned mansion of the painter Ichirō Mamiya to restore his frescos and make a documentary. Poltergeist activity begins, and the restorer Asuka is [possessed by the furious ghost of Lady Mamiya|threat|the restless dead]. In a makeshift grave the crew finds [a toddler who fell into the house's incinerator|origin|grief that will not end], and the mother [kills anyone who trespasses|rules|nothing can stop it] until the survivors find a way to [reunite her with her son|ending|the dead find peace].
